title: Compatibility Matters: A Framework for Token-Level Teacher Selection in On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.21234v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently been introduced as a promising paradigm for continual learning, where a student policy can be supervised at the token-level. Typically, OPD is performed using a single teacher per prompt rollout (or even per training run). However, this ignores a whole other axis of flexibility that is available due to the on-policy nature - token-level teacher selection during rollouts. Building on this insight, we theoretically explore what makes a teacher and a student compatible for OPD, and leverage our findings to derive several empirical heuristics for teacher selection. In particular, our framework captures several desiderata for OPD: compatible teacher-student reasoning patterns, teacher competence, and induced student diversity. Theoretically, we categorize several types of teacher routing schemes, and we prove that under different scenarios, different routing schemes are likely to be beneficial for opt

translated_title: 兼容性至关重要：在线策略蒸馏中的词元级教师选择框架
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏是最近被提出的一种有前景的持续学习范式，学生策略可以在词元级别接受监督。通常，OPD 在每个提示 rollout（甚至每次训练运行）中都使用单个教师。然而，这忽略了由在线策略特性所带来的另一维灵活性——即在 rollout 过程中进行词元级的教师选择。基于这一洞察，我们在理论上探讨了什么样的教师与学生对于 OPD 是兼容的，并利用这些发现得出了若干用于教师选择的经验性启发式方法。特别地，我们的框架涵盖了 OPD 的若干期望特性：兼容的师生推理模式、教师的能力以及所引发的学生多样性。在理论上，我们对几类教师路由方案进行了分类，并证明在不同场景下，不同的路由方案更有利于实现最优的学生学习效果。
tldr: 该论文提出在在线策略蒸馏中按词元动态选择教师的框架，从理论上刻画了师生兼容性、教师能力与学生多样性等关键因素，并证明不同场景下不同教师路由方案各有优势。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a framework for token-level teacher selection in on-policy distillation, theoretically characterizes teacher-student compatibility, teacher competence, and induced student diversity, and proves that different teacher routing schemes are beneficial under different scenarios.
